clock_conventions.affine_certificate_and_curves: D=deterministic parameter lag; u=ell=0; K=floor(B/(h+q+b)); first transition start0; last endpoint (K-1)*b+1<=K*b.
clock_conventions.exp016b: u=D retained terminal updates, ell=0; K=min(floor(Bmsg/(h+q)),floor(Benv/b)); all K charged, K-D usable; Gaussian observation indices start_environment+b*(1..K).
clock_conventions.td_mixing: P is the transition-pair kernel. Exact TV uses P_pair**b, combined across q+1 common/private sources by union bound; fresh source-choice masks do not increase TV.

saved_admission_scope: Prespecified B_value thresholds from t018, not retrospectively replaced by the repaired theorem gate. Exact-risk selector uses a stationary mean proxy; empirical Gaussian uses a pseudo-observation and FIFO layer reports an averaged parameter.
conditional_theorem_scope: Applies when all selected actions have valid post-probe conditional upper certificates; the new theorem uses actual selected-action certificates and needs no global scalar-solver claim.
